title: Reconfigurable topological valley-Hall interfaces: Asymptotics of arrays of Dirichlet and Neumann inclusions for multiple scattering in metamaterials
summary: We study two-dimensional periodic metamaterials in which idealised cylindrical inclusions are modelled by boundary conditions. In the scalar time-harmonic setting, the background field satisfies the Helmholtz equation, and high-contrast inclusion limits reduce to Dirichlet or Neumann conditions, with direct analogues in dielectric and acoustic media.
